The input/output and stage panels below describe the task; the evaluation runner’s saved prompt and visible-file manifest identify the actual entry point. A stored instruction is distinct from the runtime launch message, which can add framing and execution limits. The agent uses the harness’s file-reading tools to inspect available inputs.
